mapper.sql: SELECT a.appeal_id AS appealId, a.order_id AS orderId, a.user_id AS userId, a.reason AS reason, a.detail AS detail, a.status AS status, a.handle_by AS handleBy, a.handle_comment AS handleComment, a.create_time AS createTime, a.handle_time AS handleTime, u.username AS username, o.order_status AS orderStatus, g.goods_name AS goodsName, bu.username AS buyerName, su.username AS sellerName, hu.username AS handlerName FROM trade_appeal a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON a.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.goods_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` su ON o.seller_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` hu ON a.handle_by = hu.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_appeal (order_id, user_id, reason, detail, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT appeal_id AS appealId, order_id AS orderId, user_id AS userId, reason AS reason, detail AS detail, status AS status, handle_by AS handleBy, handle_comment AS handleComment, create_time AS createTime, handle_time AS handleTime FROM trade_appeal WHERE appeal_id = #{appealId}
WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.appeal_id DESC

AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY a.status ASC, a.create_time DESC, a.appeal_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_appeal SET status = #{status}, handle_by = #{handleBy}, handle_comment = #{handleComment}, handle_time = NOW() WHERE appeal_id = #{appealId}
